[2026-08-28T04:24:41.382Z] [debug] scene: loc=iskan_veil hub=- arrival=n opening=n passing=n
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.467Z] [world] A wall of grey ash rolls across the plain. Breathing burns. Skin gathers a film of dead world.

You are at Iskan-Veil. A far-northwestern Lost Capital. The Conspiracy Architects' hidden city — a maze of false doors and overlaid corridors. Every map of Iskan-Veil is wrong by design; the true Core seat is behind the door you didn't see.

Hazard: Aether Mist. A glowing low mist that pulses with each heartbeat — yours, or something else's.
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.468Z] [world] You have been here. The shape of it comes back before the details do. The bodies you left are still here. Nothing has moved in to replace them.
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.469Z] [world] [Iskan-Veil] north: open ground · east: The Monarch's Waystation (3 tiles, 8 hours) · south: Reclaimer's Stake (2 tiles, 5 hours) · west: open ground
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.469Z] [world] The Cartographer (Keeper of Quiet Plans) is already here when you arrive, stall half-unpacked. They look up and nod once.
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.470Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter inclines their head toward the newcomer. "The Cartographer, Keeper of Quiet Plans. A hooded figure who never gives a name, only a nod. Deals in what other people would rather you didn't have — q
uiet boots, charms that swallow sound, maps of doors that aren't on any map. Speaks in implications and watches the exits."
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.474Z] [world] Rare workings for sale: Void Edge (500 TC) — buy one by name to learn it. This one also mends worn gear, trains a stat for coin, and patches up a hurt dog or golem — just ask.
[2026-08-28T04:24:41.480Z] [reward] ✦ Resurrection. Great Scott returns to Tartaria, restored. The Aetherstone hums in recognition.
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.235Z] [player] Ask about their trade
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.239Z] [world] "Maps," says the Cartographer. "Of places. Some of which are still there."
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.240Z] [world] The Cartographer places you, roughly, and adjusts what they were about to say.
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.987Z] [player] Ask what a map costs
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.988Z] [world] "Depends what is on it." The Cartographer does not reach for anything. "A road anyone can walk, two coins. A road with a reason nobody walks it, considerably more — and the price is the reason, 
not the paper." A pause of exactly the right length. "There are three I do not price at all. I would rather keep them than be asked where I got them."
[2026-08-28T04:24:46.989Z] [world] There is half a nod in it — you are a face now, if not much more than one.
[2026-08-28T04:24:49.153Z] [world] You let the conversation go and The Cartographer gets back to it.
